decisions.reason: The 500mA rating applies to the MT3608 5V boost rail, not the independently specified DCDC1 3.3V output rated at 2A.
The switched 5V load specification does not change the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail, its loads, or its activation condition.
The AXP2101 normal-operation and battery power-path facts are independently and already represented from the same message; the 5V rail load details require no additional candidate-state change.
The reference to SK6812 LEDs operating from 5V does not specifically identify or change the separate charge-status indication circuit or its connector and resistor configuration.
The switched 5V rail's rating and attached loads do not change the ESP32 sleep policy, wake sources, clocks, or deep-sleep behavior.
The source does not change the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, physical access, or unresolved pin order.
The 5V boost-rail load allocation does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or thermal-protection requirements.
GPIO3 control of the 5V rail is already represented by the candidate's same-message introduction, and the source MODIFY does not assign a different GPIO.
The source confirms GPIO control of the rail but does not alter the existing 5V_EN interboard signal, connector, or pinout.
Electrical load allocation and boost-current rating do not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector-placement constraints.
The source does not change the interboard power connector type, pin count, matching rule, or any current pin assignment.
The source mentions SK6812 LEDs conditionally powered from 5V but does not identify the separate eight-LED board or necessarily change its board-level requirement.
